You guys legitimately fumbled one of the most cool and diverse communities in gaming history just because the shareholders said so. The game genuinely feels awful to play ever since the movement update, and you guys have nerfed every single good survivor perk to the ground while dropping new disgusting killer perks every single expansion. Meanwhile, every new survivor perk is extremely situational and would only extend the chase for a few seconds, IF EVEN.

Not to mention the map design and generation being so terrible now, to the point that you guys made Windows of Opportunity META. Do you understand how bad it is that a perk that helps you navigate the map, and used to have an abysmal usage rate skyrocket after the map changes?

If there was any salvation for this game, it would be a classic game mode with old perks and movement. The game feels miserable to play now as survivor, and boring as killer. At least other terrible games have quick queue times, why would I wait 20 minutes to get tunneled out and have every generator I work on have it's progress reduced every 20 seconds? The fall from grace is historic, and it's a surprise no one talks about it. The only people that play this game are old school players trying to cling to the past glory of this washed game.

DBD is a really, really unique game that you can't really find a competitor on market. The amount of license, the vibrant community, and the skill celling, all makes this game incredibly riveting. You can play DBD for like ~5 hours with friends for some good time, or you can be a loser like me devoting thousands of hours into this game.
If you are willing to actually 'get good' at this game, be aware that you will need to play for least 100 hours to be somewhat potent against skilled players. And also be aware that there are tons of toxic loser in this game especially at mid-skill level. 
Have fun :D

A lot can be said about how the dev team will always find a way to ruin something that the player base was able to mostly agree on being fun. That is not why I'm leaving this review, as I don't think my personal woes with the state of the game and their constant changes to perks and powers on both sides being unfair to all players in general.

No. As it stands, Dead by Daylight would rather support a streamer who is notable for his and his fanbase's intolerant and disgusting comments towards the very communities that have supported DbD over the years. Dead by Daylight claims to be in support of the LGBTQ+ community, yet they have just provided a massive free DLC bundle to someone who spreads hatred about them.

I am fed up with the way this game and their devs treat their players. If you want to play a game that will be nothing but an aggravation because of the constant changes for the worse, go right ahead. I won't bother with this game until they make a beyond adequate correction of this disgusting show of community betrayal and greed.
